scope: T00 frozen protocol only; no provider dispatch or secret access performed
freezeState: frozen-before-model-output; final package fingerprints and runtime materialization by root
accessApprovalStatus: T06待批准; blocks real dispatch only
humanRoleStatus: unassigned; blocks human choices/judgment/comparison claims only; never infer human from agent automation

attemptRules: Initial attempt plus at most one bounded actual repair/retry; same slot and logical requestId, unique attemptId.
Every attempt reruns gate/reservation/dispatch; no automatic repair after cancellation/permission withdrawal.
Every initial result remains in original denominator even if attempt2 repairs it.
Unknown dispatch/usage retains reservation and single-flight occupancy until reconciled; later slots blocked, never silently skipped or renumbered.
A child request is a distinct one of the frozen six slots, never an attempt/zero-cost tool step.
Missing budget: blocked or reviewed/re-frozen new version; never shrink original scope and claim original pass.

patches.value: 方向键或WASD移动，拿到10分过关。普通点心1分，特别点心3分；碰到守卫失败。

FX-A.note: P05 A: review.3 risk geometry, goal10, speed100/detect180, timer disabled/limit45. Source semanticHash is stale after patch and MUST be recomputed by T01; do not trust embedded source digest.

FX-B.note: P05 B: player+5 normal, no guard/high, goal4, disabled timer/limit30.

FX-E11.expectedGenerationCondition: tick900 real first score1/goalReached, guard contact and timer expiry; round_ended reason=caught by precedence; actual runtime must validate, not assume computed expectations are evidence.
FX-E11.selection: Minimal actual same-tick scoring/goal_checked/guard contact/round_ended chain and necessary causes; actual @3 fields and original rules.
FX-E11.repeatRule: Each repeat resets frozen initial document and creates a distinct real run; no copying evidence between repetitions.
FX-E11.humanFollowupRule: Human chooses one actual offered supported minimal change; if actual option moves n1 to(40,290), it is eligible; do not inject it into parent response or promise win. Recheck same frozen inputs and report support/refutation/unknown.
requirements: Do not use K03 or run_evidence_example.
Record full initial document, tick inputs, runId, revision, semanticHash, buildHash/runtimeArtifactHash and actual collect-chase-evidence@3.
Block AI11/follow-ups if fixed caught case does not generate real required evidence; no opportunistic replacement or new model slot.

FX-E12.note: Choose P05 no-actual-events variant, identically on both repetitions; do not silently substitute truncated chain.

FX-PROBE.outboundIntent: 只说明当前是否有守卫及当前目标分数，不提出修改。
FX-PROBE.expected: Read-only answered; no operations, current guard count0 and goal4.

outboundFieldsWhitelist: bounded current scene/rules and applicable theme catalog
eligible actual parent output and human chosen option only for child
selected actual @3 minimal event chain and original rule snapshot only for AI11
explicit none/coverage marker only for AI12
